points.description: States that the statement is FALSE (the OS does not execute the next instruction after the faulting instruction).
States that after the handler creates the mapping (allocates the physical page and updates the page table), it returns from the handler and re-executes the faulting instruction itself.
points.partial_credit: Half only if it says the faulting instruction is retried/re-executed but omits the handler creating the mapping and returning from the handler.

points.description: States that on a page fault the PC is not incremented (PC still points to the faulting instruction), so the next instruction is not executed.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE, the correct reason that the faulting instruction is re-executed after the handler returns, and that the PC is not incremented. Answers that say only FALSE, or give a vague reason without stating re-execution of the faulting instruction, earn at most 0.5. Answering TRUE, or any wrong statement about the mechanism (e.g. the next instruction runs), earns 0 for the affected point.
